I will plant improved maize seed because I saw it do better for people nearby when the rains come well, but I will not spend too much cash on chemicals. I will put some fertilizer, but not a heavy amount, and I will also use the manure I can get because this is my own land and I want to keep it producing. I will not irrigate because here I depend on the rains, and I will not buy pesticide this season; I will use family work and some hired labor for planting and weeding.
